name: maiboli
description: Speak in your mother tongue — Hindi, Marathi, Spanish, and 55+ more languages — and get English text at your cursor. Works in code files, terminals, and AI chat boxes.

maiboli.provider.description: Which speech engine to use. 'whisper' = OpenAI (any of 55+ languages -> English). 'sarvam' = Sarvam AI (best for Indian languages and Hinglish). 'gemini' = Google Gemini (audio -> English in one call, polishes too when Rewrite is on; has a free tier).

maiboli.openaiApiKey.description: Your OpenAI API key (for provider = whisper, and for GPT polishing).

maiboli.sarvamApiKey.description: Your Sarvam API key (for provider = sarvam, and for sarvam-m polishing).

maiboli.geminiApiKey.description: Your Google Gemini API key (for provider = gemini, and for Gemini polishing). Free tier at aistudio.google.com.

maiboli.rewrite.description: Polish the transcribed English with an AI rewrite (fixes grammar, removes fillers, joins broken sentences). Toggle quickly via the 'Maiboli: Toggle AI Rewrite' command.

maiboli.rewriteProvider.description: Which AI polishes the text when Rewrite is on. 'auto' picks the first key you have set, preferring OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini), then Sarvam (sarvam-m), then Gemini. Not used when provider = gemini (it polishes in the same call).

maiboli.geminiModel.description: Gemini model used for transcription and polishing (e.g. gemini-2.5-flash, or a newer flash model).

maiboli.recorder.description: Which tool records your mic. 'sox' is simplest and works on Mac + Windows. 'ffmpeg' is Mac-only.

maiboli.recorderPath.description: Optional: full path to sox/ffmpeg if VS Code can't find it (e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/sox or C:\Program Files (x86)\sox-14-4-2\sox.exe).
